message:
`createUser` now accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it (`null` when not set). `npm test` passes: all 3 tests, including the two in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

- **`src/api/users.js`:** `createUser` stores the nickname, and `getUser` returns it.
- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`:** this new migration adds the `nickname` column, because the in-memory `Db` rejects unknown columns on insert. I left 001 and 002 alone since they're already applied in production.

The migrations README says that directory is owned by the DBA team. I only added a new file there, but you may want them to look at it.
